# Warped City (CC0)

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/warped-city
Artwork by Luis Zuno ([@ansimuz](https://ansimuz.com)).

The artwork is public domain (CC0): "free to use on whatever you want, personal or commercial. Credit is not required but appreciated." The author's original notice is in `LICENSE-original.txt`. The pack's music has a separate license and is **not** included here.

Only the files this game uses are kept. `scripts/import_env.py` crops and composes them into `public/art/`.
